spans.s:
Omnipotent,Ⓒa.ⒹsarvaSaktimat, sarvasamarTa-Sakti, amita-apAra-Sakti.
ⓃOmnipotence, [Omnipoten]cy,Ⓒs.ⒹsarvaSaktitvaM, apAra-amita-Sakti f., sarvasAmarTyaM, anaMtaSaktiH.

Omnipresent,Ⓒa.Ⓓsarvagata, sarvAtmaka, sarva-viSva-vyApin, viSvAtman, viSvarUpa.
ⓃOmnipresence,Ⓒs.Ⓓsarva-viSva-vyApti f., viSvA-tmatA, viSvarUpatA, sarva-viSvavyApitA.

Omniscient,Ⓒa.ⒹsarvajYa, sarvavid-vedin-buD, sarvadarSin-sAkzin, viSvanetra, trikAlajYa.
ⓃOmniscience,Ⓒs.ⒹsarvajYatvaM, sarvajYAnaM.
